b4a1347108be95541c75252eac3c8e5b.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm
paragraphs: Pyongyang, June 1 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm on May 31.
He was accompanied by senior Party and government officials.

The greenhouse farm, built on the bank of the Amnok River in the northwestern part of the country as an outcome of the WPK's noble ideal and long-cherished desire, has a rich vegetable harvest at present. And its hundreds of hectares are covered with rape flowers in full bloom, which add to the scenic beauty of the Wihwa Island.
Comrade Kim Jong Un was greeted by Yang Myong Chol, chief secretary of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the WPK, and officials of the farm.

Going round hydroponic and soil greenhouses of different styles and experimental cultivation greenhouses, he learned in detail about the production, vegetable science research and management of the farm.

Expressing satisfaction over the report of the farm manager that the greenhouse farm has harvested hundreds of tons of various vegetables in tens of species at over 1 150 greenhouses every day and supplied them to orphanages, baby homes, primary schools for orphans and commercial units on a regular basis to contribute to improving the diet of regional people, he highly appreciated the patriotic devotion of its agricultural workers who are demonstrating the validity and vitality of the Party's policy with their pure conscience and production results.

Saying it is urgent to minimize energy consumption in the production of vegetables and provide effective and appropriate environment for the growth of different varieties of vegetables so as to reduce costs and cultivate vegetables in all seasons, he clarified in detail the scientific and technological issues to this end.

The farm should not place importance on the productivity alone, but increase the variety of vegetables and cultivate them in a sci-tech way to provide the people with nutritious and tasty vegetables, he said, adding that it is necessary to actively organize a socialist emulation among farms.

Stating that it is an important policy issue stressed by the Party for greenhouse farms to raise the proportion of farm work done by machines and automate the carrying means, he taught the ways for its implementation.

Noting that the Sinuiju Vegetable Science Research Center has a very important duty in putting the greenhouse vegetable production on a scientific basis, he stressed that when it properly plays its role as an academic guidance unit and as a scientific research and dissemination base which comprehensively leads the work of breeding, researching, cultivating and disseminating vegetable seeds, it is possible to promote the trend for developing the greenhouse farms, to be built across the country, in a balanced and planned way.

He said that the Agricultural Commission and other relevant units should properly appreciate the research achievements proving effective in practice during review of the greenhouse vegetable production, help share the experience with each other, set forth new research assignments and learn about their implementation on a regular basis and take necessary measures. He also underlined the need to study about mechanism measure for the Sinuiju vegetable science research base in order to quickly apply the research successes to all the greenhouse farms of the country.

He set forth important tasks for the long-term development of greenhouse farms, including the issue of increasing the number of vegetable storage facilities and greengroceries to provide the people in the province with fresh vegetables on a regular basis, the issue of establishing a well-regulated system for rapidly disseminating new advanced technologies to the greenhouse vegetable sector and the issue of establishing a system for training greenhouse experts.
Then he toured rape fields full of fragrant flowers.
He said with pleasure that the rape fields are really spectacular as they presented a peculiar sight of a large, picturesque farm town.

He said that the beautiful appearance of the island area with a sea of greenhouse vegetables and rape flowers is reminiscent of the course of transformation in the area of the Wihwa Island and that this change is a proud epitome of socialist Korea showing the true meaning of dramatic transformation in the new era.

Saying that the Party attached importance to both greenhouse farming and ecological and environmental protection work while building the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm, he stressed the need for the farm to properly protect and maintain the river and road and take care of the surrounding environments, including residential quarters, parks, ponds, embankments and street trees, in a scientific, cultured and hygienic and responsible manner.

The farm is just a visual aid and a textbook for practical education which comprehensively reflects the Party's policy, he said, affirming that the Party would make more strenuous efforts for the radical transformation of regions with the development of the Wihwa Island as a starting point and turn all farms and regions of the country into modern socialist villages and ideal land for the people without fail.

That day, Comrade Kim Jong Un inspected an advanced public health establishment, a leisure complex and a combined vegetable processing factory being built in the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm area to carry out the tasks for the third year of implementing the Party's policy on the regional development.
He heard a report about progress in the construction project from the commanding officer of military unit involved in it.

Thanks to the devoted efforts of soldier-builders with the strong will of loyalty to register greater miracles and feats in the 2026 book of combat for realizing the Party's long-cherished desire, the construction project for the regional development policy in this area is now being pushed forward at 50 percent of the total project.

Comrade Kim Jong Un said that he was really pleased to see the modern hospital, multi-functional leisure complex and specialized vegetable processing factory being vigorously built in the significant place, where the inauguration of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm was declared, to contribute to the promotion of regional people's health and the improvement of their cultural life. The area of the Wihwa Island will be described again as a model and a standard of regional transformation in the new era when the construction of those objects is completed, he added.

He highly appreciated the fact that the specialization of construction units has been further improved and the ranks of skilled persons are being strengthened as required by the Party policy. And he stressed the need to provide more construction equipment and show deep care for the soldier-builders' living and took necessary technical measures.

He stressed that constant efforts should be directed to the political and ideological education of soldier-builders to prepare all of them to be ardent patriots who find genuine pride and worth of life in serving the country and the people, and staunch defenders and reliable implementers of the regional development policy of the WPK.

Noting that the land of the country will be richer and more beautiful along with the ongoing patriotic advance, he expressed expectation and conviction that all the soldier-builders would more courageously write another chapter of uninterrupted innovations and progress in the vanguard of accomplishing the honorable cause. -0-

5a5afdd9fddfe454d6e2bfda3519c492.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Pays Congratulatory Visit to Central Cadres Training School of WPK on Its 80th Founding Anniversary
paragraphs: Pyongyang, June 2 (KCNA) -- The Central Cadres Training School of the Workers' Party of Korea, a prestigious political school of the WPK and the highest seat of training cadres of the Party, is proudly marking its 80th founding anniversary in its glorious history.

The Central Cadres Training School has successfully carried out its strategic and historic duty, entrusted by the times and the revolution, in the van of accomplishing the sacred cause of eternally carrying forward the lifeline of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Party and its ever-victorious leadership and firmly guaranteeing the bright prospect of the Juche cause. Such contribution of the school serves as a solid cornerstone supporting the immortal dignity and honor of the WPK which is writing the longest history as a socialist ruling party.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, paid a congratulatory visit to the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK marking its 80th founding anniversary on June 1.

The revolutionary university, which stands imposingly in the historic Kumsusan area as a symbol of the absolute prestige of the WPK and the invincibility of our cause, was filled with great excitement and joy of all its teaching staff and students who had the greatest honor and happiness of having Comrade Kim Jong Un on its campus on the significant 80th founding anniversary.
When Comrade Kim Jong Un arrived, all the participants broke into thunderous cheers of "Hurrah!".

They paid the highest tribute and gratitude to Comrade Kim Jong Un, the most faithful successor to the sacred cause of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the peerlessly great political master and the great teacher, who visited the school with ardent love, trust and warm blessing.
Comrade Kim Jong Un was courteously greeted by Ri Yong Sik, headmaster of the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK, and Paek Hyong Chol, secretary of its primary committee of the WPK.
He was presented with bouquets of fragrant flowers by the school's educational workers.

He warmly congratulated all the teaching staff and students of the school on its significant 80th founding anniversary as they are performing brilliant feats with honor by making tangible contribution to organizational and ideological strengthening of the Party and its leadership activities through educational practice and scientific activities and with good scholastic attainments at a time when the new era of Party building and the great period of national rejuvenation are being ushered in.

Present at the celebrations were secretaries and other officials of the Central Committee of the WPK, the teaching staff and students of the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK and educational workers and students of the provincial Party schools across the country.
Present there on invitation were the veteran educators who made distinguished contributions to training Party cadres.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a significant speech on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK.

He appreciated the special position and dignity and the high honor of the Central Cadres Training School, which has vigorously developed into a reliable cadre-training base of the WPK both in name and in reality for the past 80 years since it was founded with 80 students holding in high esteem the great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung as its first headmaster on June 1, 1946, and is now purely glorifying its sacred original name as a political and educational institution faithfully serving the cause of Juche-oriented Party building and as a strategic fortress guaranteeing the existence and development of the Party.

The original idea of founding the school that it is hard to expect the building of a prosperous state apart from the core and leading role of the Party cadres and the training of Party cadres should be put above all other affairs remains an absolute truth even now after 80 years, he said, referring to the strategic intention of the WPK attaching greater importance to the training of Party cadres and its inevitability at a time when the socialist construction is in the era of transformation which no one has ever experienced and the struggle for realizing the people's ideal is being intensified as never before.

He said that if the Party is to become strong and the country to develop, the pedigree establishment for training hard-core cadres of the Party should be firm and the top-ranking talents of our country should be trained. And he set forth in detail the important principles and educational and practical directions to be adhered to by the Party political school in remaining faithful to its character, nature and mission and training the reserves of the Party into core elements possessed of the Juche outlook on the revolution, life and morality despite the passage of time and the steady replacement of generations.

He wished the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK only glory in the future, ardently calling for making the glorious moment of today, which marks another significant starting point in the development of the WPK and the revolution, lead onto the brighter future and more courageously opening up the great course of party building in the new era.

All the participants, receiving with boundless excitement the profound guidelines guaranteeing the bright future of strengthening the whole Party in the new era, broke into enthusiastic cheers amid a thunderous clapping of hands, expressing their determination to remain unfailingly faithful to the cause of Juche-oriented party building as the true personifiers of the red-flag spirit firmly armed with the revolutionary idea of the Party Central Committee and the standard-bearers of the revolution steadfastly carrying forward the glory of the Party and guaranteeing its future.
Comrade Kim Jong Un went round the room dedicated to the history of the school.

Our cause of Party building has never experienced a moment of stagnation or frustration even in the years of the arduous revolution, thanks to the Party cadres training bases which have invariably served as a nutrition for the Juche-oriented cause of Party building from the very day of the Party founding, he said, adding that it is the great pride and strength of the WPK to have such a prestigious educational base and strong theoretical base as the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK which is reliably supporting the struggle of the socialist ruling Party while maintaining the high sense of responsibility for the revolutionary cause, sincere research attitude and substantial teaching strategy.

He stressed that even though the Party's revolutionary idea is great and its exploits enormous, it is impossible to expect the Party's long-term development and steady succession to the revolutionary cause if the Party fails to successfully train its successors, and that the Central Cadres Training School should ceaselessly enhance the leadership and fighting efficiency for the permanent existence and continued victorious development of the Party and consolidate its eternal prosperity in conformity with the important mission given by the times and the revolution.

It is the guarantee for invincibility of the revolutionary Party and the law of its rule to highly value its sacred first page and steadfastly carry it forward as the history becomes longer and exploits are accumulated, he said, stressing that the school should steadily glorify its noble position and duty as the main base and think-tank of the Party's ideo-theoretical building in the work of intensifying the education and struggle to maintain and give full play to the Party's original ideals and determination and qualitatively training the hard-core elements possessed of the revolutionary climate inherent in the Party as their mental qualities.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un had a photo taken with the teaching staff of the Central Cadres Training School, who are devoting their high qualifications as educators, Party conscience and revolutionary enthusiasm to the sacred school platform related to the eternal future of the Party, on the occasion of the significant founding anniversary of the school.

The role of the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK just means the strengthening and development of the WPK and the eternal future of the Party building depends on every step of this political school, he said, expressing expectation and belief that the school will further strive to strengthen the Party and brilliantly accomplish its sacred action programs, always sharing the intention, will and practice with the Party Central Committee.

Then, he also had a photo taken with the educational workers of the provincial Party schools who were invited to the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the Central Cadres Training School, which will be eternally recorded in the history of Party building.

All the participants hardened their will to more creditably and steadfastly carry out the duty of the glorious political school with their great efforts and successes in the educational work, bearing deeper in mind the honor of being committed revolutionaries who are training the reserves of the Party.
The women's soccer teams, who won gold medals in the international games for the honor of the motherland, had a demonstration match to commemorate the 80th founding anniversary of the school.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un watched the match together with the participants in the celebrations.

Prior to the match, he met and warmly congratulated the players and coaches of the National Soccer Team, the winner of the 2026 AFC U-17 Women's Asian Cup, and the Naegohyang Team who won the trophy in the 2025-2026 AFC Women's Champions League.

He warmly took the trustworthy women players, proud daughters of the motherland, to his arms and had a photo session with them, hoping that they will support the country by winning more gold medals, more brilliant trophies associated with their patriotism.
The conspicuous match started amid high spirit and excitement of the women players honored with great love and trust of the fatherly Marshal.
The match, in which the players displayed high competitive spirit, impressively decorated the end of the celebrations.

At the end of the match, the participants raised roaring cheers of "Hurrah!" as an eruption of their joy and excitement of spending together with the benevolent father dream-like pleasant and happy time that they would recollect in their lifetime.

Comrade Kim Jong Un warmly waved back to the enthusiastically cheering participants, expressing his hope that the pedigree establishments for training the backbone of the WPK, which upheld its glorious history as a ruling party, would achieve more remarkable successes in education and gain higher academic authority.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's guidance to the supreme political school of the DPRK will be registered in the history of Party building in the new era as a sacred footprints he made to ensure forever the eternal continuity and invincibility of the Juche revolution and usher in the more bright and hopeful era of prosperity before the Party and the country by giving definite precedence to the work for the future of the Party over all other affairs. -0-

dc7583f364d9a5f1c67a2da706ba451a.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Delivers Important Speech on Occasion of 80th Founding Anniversary of Central Cadres Training School of Workers' Party of Korea
paragraphs: Pyongyang, June 2 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, paid a congratulatory visit to the Central Cadres Training School of the Workers' Party of Korea greeting its 80th founding anniversary on June 1, and made a meaningful speech before its teaching staff and students and the education workers and students from provincial Party schools across the country.
He said:
Comrades,
Today the Central Cadres Training School of the Workers' Party of Korea marks its 80th founding anniversary.
I warmly congratulate all its teaching staff and students on this very significant day.

Also present here are the education workers from provincial Party schools, and I extend warm greetings, through you, to the teaching staff and students of Party schools at all levels throughout the country.

I also pay tribute to the educators and meritorious persons of the preceding generations who made a distinguished contribution to the training of Party cadres as they faithfully worked at Party schools until the twilight years of their life.
Today I am really filled with deep emotion as we are to mark in splendour the 80th founding anniversary on this campus truthfully reminiscent of the high dignity and sacred course of our Party.

Celebrating the occasion, when the glorious history of the school is connected with its rosier future, can be called a demonstration of our faith and will to carry forward the revolutionary ideology and Party building ideal of Juche with a firm conviction in them and in their pure form without the slightest deviation.

In looking back upon the history of political parties of the working class, there is no party other than ours that established bases for training its cadres by itself through a well-regulated system and structure, bases capable of training its hard core, from the centre down to the regional areas in a little over a year after its founding.

It was a truly correct and far-sighted measure to have laid the foundation for training Party cadres armed with our ideology and traditions and the mode of struggle of our own style in the difficult and complicated situation immediately after the country's liberation, when there was almost nothing to rely on, proceeding from the Juche-oriented standpoint that even though the problem of technical personnel could be solved by means of training them abroad, political activists who would serve as pillars of the Party and revolution of our country should be trained by our own efforts.

In its 80-year history since June 1, 1946, when its founding was declared with the great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung as the first principal and only 80 persons as students, the Central Cadres Training School has made a steady growth into a reliable cadres training base of the WPK both in name and reality. Today, too, it is adding lustre to its sacred original name without marring it in the slightest, the appellation for a political educational institution faithfully serving the Juche-oriented Party building cause and for a strategic fortress guaranteeing the existence and development of the Party.

As a matter of fact, our Central Cadres Training School is the only political school which has laid such a solid foundation for and given nourishment to the cause of building the working-class party, which has continued from one century to the next and from one generation to the next, while going through the arduous years of the revolution together with the Party since its birth.
In this sacred course, the school has gained great honour and reputation and also preserved them.

The many hard-core elements educated and trained here have played the role of the backbone in strengthening all levels of the Party, ranging from its grass-roots organizations to its central committee, organizationally and ideologically, and are performing the important duty of leading the development of the political, military, economic, cultural and all other spheres of state and social life.

The Central Cadres Training School, shouldering the responsible mission of guaranteeing the eternal future of the Party and the revolution, has made a tangible contribution to training Party cadres equipped with faithfulness and high practical qualifications and to enriching the treasure house of the theory of building a revolutionary party. This firm stronghold has made it possible for the WPK to chronicle its sacred chapters without any mistakes or twists even in the tempest of history and maintain its dignity still today with outstanding leadership abilities.

During its shining 80 years the school has left indelible imprints in the development of the Party and served as its powerful base for preserving the immutable revolutionary genes for the succession to its cause that will not deflect even in the coming 80, nay 800, years. This constitutes the outstanding position and matchless authority unique to the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK.
Comrades,

Building a prosperous and powerful state is inconceivable separated from the core and leading role of Party cadres and training Party cadres should be put above all other affairs. The aim of the founding of this school remains an absolute truth even today, 80 years later.
As everyone feels and experiences, the reality is changing very rapidly and our socialist construction is going through an era of transformation, which no one has ever witnessed.

Our Party is vigorously promoting crucial policies aimed at radically boosting the overall strength of the country and transforming its appearance; accordingly, the struggle to realize the people's ideals is expanding to an unprecedented scale.
That is why we can say that this is the time when the role of Party cadres is highlighted more than ever before.

But the point is that there are not many competent Party cadres capable of perfectly carrying out the Party's ideas and policies in the theatres of gigantic struggle for transformation that is going on more extensively and intensively as the days go by, the hard core capable of organizing their work in keeping with the changing reality and the high demands and standards of the developing times.

Comrade Kim Jong Un, after analyzing the current overall level and abilities of cadres, referred to the urgent need to decisively enhance the role of the cadres training schools of the Party, whose course is compulsory for all cadres to attend, and continued:

It can be said that this is an era when talented persons, not material resources like technical means or natural resources, are considered to be the No. 1 strategic resources of the state, and that the level of development of the socialist state depends entirely on the level of the cadres of its ruling party.
Training Party cadres has never been separated from the existence and development of our Party and state, but this has never been such a pressing and vital task as it is today, I think.

Of course, some who are loyal and talented can be found in reality, but the ranks of Party cadres needed for all the fronts and their boundaries of the revolution that is developing in depth can only be trained through the specialist education of Party officials.

If the Party is to be strong and the country is to develop, the "pedigree" institution for training hard-core cadres of the Party should be firm, and talents of the talents of our country must be produced by this institution.

Another reason why we attach top priority to Party school education is that, with the change of generations in the revolution, people of younger generations, who are short of tempering in Party life and differ in sensitiveness from their preceding generations, make up the main ranks of cadres.

Comrade Kim Jong Un referred to the prevailing situation, in which cadres of younger generations who have had no chance to undergo trying ordeals like war and postwar rehabilitation, are betraying bigger and bigger differences in the spiritual world and personal quality from those of their preceding generations.
Clarifying how to tide it over, he stressed:

This shows that the younger they are, the greater attention should be paid to training them in Party spirit and transforming them along revolutionary lines and that a higher level and target should be adopted in deciding the educational content and methods.

We have to prevent the awareness of the younger generations from receding from the ideals and faith of their revolutionary forerunners, and ensure that the whole society is filled with their ethos of indomitability and staunchness with which to fight resiliently against all odds and challenges. To this end, Party schools should play their role in a responsible manner as political institutions which are assigned to get rid of all alien things and inject only the pure revolutionary spirit.

Party schools should put their teaching levels and educational environment and climate onto a highest possible phase. In this way, they can produce genuine Party officials worthy of the name, who are ready to work heart and soul for supporting the Party's leadership, instead of simply turning out their graduates who pay lip service to the concepts and text of the five-point line of Party building in the new era.

In other words, they should hold fast to their original features and ethos as the Party's political schools despite the passage of time and the uninterrupted change of generations, and train Party cadres who are indispensable to the country, people who are prepared to devote themselves to the good of their fellow people, the source of their own life, while sharing ideology, intentions and ideals with the Party Central Committee.

Hoping that the teaching staff and students of the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK as well as all its graduates will be boundlessly loyal to the great mission assigned by the Party, state and people, and meet the requirements of our developing revolution, I would like to avail myself of this opportunity to emphasize some things.

What I want you to refresh your memory of on this occasion today is that the Central Cadres Training School is, in name and reality, a Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist school, a school of the Party Central Committee.

Even when everything else in the world may change, the original feature of the Workers' Party of Korea must remain as it is. Likewise, even when its educational environment and teaching and edification modes may change, the character and mission of the Party school must remain unchanged.

This may be what we have said time and again, and yet we should be mindful at all times of why we established our own Party school on the debris when parties in other countries in the same situation asked those countries that had accomplished their revolution earlier to train their own cadres.

Our Party, since it newly built the Central Cadres Training School at this sacred place, has been doing its utmost to provide the school with the highest level of working, learning and living conditions. This is, in the final analysis, aimed at training the elite who are thoroughly armed with the ideology of the WPK.
Our revolution has got a unitary character which should remain absolute and immutable for its steady succession and accomplishment.
That is the single guiding ideology, single leadership centre and single leadership system.

Only those who, cherishing unshakeable trust in their Party, have committed themselves to following it on the road of revolution against all odds, will not bend the knee or yield to power, nor will they tend to swim with the tide.
Whoever has graduated from the Central Cadres Training School must, above all else, be uncompromising when it comes to keeping revolutionary faith and principles.

The type of official our Party needs is one who regards its ideology and purpose as an absolute truth and never recognizes anything other than them, and who can carry out its policies unconditionally, come what may.

Graduates from Party schools, however many there may be and whatever character or qualifications they may have, should be one and the same in terms of the spirit and mettle with which to defend the validity of the Party's lines and policies.

The Central Cadres Training School produces 200 or so graduates a year. If they are all prepared to be pure-hearted and honest loyalists who are steadfast in ideology and faith, our Party's ranks of cadres will become a rock-solid buttress supporting the Party and the government, a powerful propellant for advancing the Korean revolution straight ahead while wiping away all manner of undesirable elements.

Over the past eight decades after emerging as a communist school, this school has put the main emphasis on tempering its students' loyalty to the Party. Just as in the past, it should design its curriculum as a course of mental training for helping the students cherish the Party Central Committee's intentions and will as an element of their faith, not merely as a course of imparting theories and knowledge to them; it should also organize the students' daily routine in ways that will facilitate the training of their ideology and willpower and cultivate their mental qualities, that is, improve their loyalty to the Party and foster the spirit of devotion to revolutionary tasks and ennobling personality. Such should be established as the Party school's peculiar climate.

The school should ensure that its students, while learning on the noble campus, seek an instinctive understanding of what the Party's aim is, what it is concerned about and how they should act to defend the authority of the Party Central Committee.

The fighters who pioneered our revolution cherished loyalty to the revolution as something like an inborn quality, even though they were denied access to regular education. Throwing themselves unhesitatingly into doing something that is most challenging, most urgent or most pressing--this was a source of infinite honour, glory and pride for them. Established as the mental mainstay of this country, this priceless tradition has influenced its successive generations.

Party schools ought to stand at the forefront of the effort to carry forward the ideological bloodline of our Party and the pure soul of the Juche revolution. So, they should naturally conduct revolutionary education and edification to raise the students' ideological spirit up to the level of our first-generation revolutionaries' mental world.
An important factor in qualifying the students as Party officials is to ensure that they get into the habit of acting in accordance with Party Rules and the regulations of Party life.

Only when all the members of society observe the laws of the state, will everything in the country go well. Likewise, if our officials make it part of their habit to act in strict accordance with Party Rules, success will be assured in all the aspects of work, like establishing the unified leadership system of the Party Central Committee and cultivating loyalty to the Party, the revolution and the people.

It is important to make an exacting demand on the students so that they act in strict accordance with Party Rules and the regulations of Party life, use all the opportunities and processes for tempering loyalty to the Party so effectively as to help them develop mentally and raise their political awareness, and put their daily routine on a highly regular basis as appropriate for the climate of the Party's political school.
Party schools should pay special attention to ensuring that the students acquire the moral qualities befitting the officials of the ruling Party.
If an ideology and ideal is to serve as the banner of great ennobling struggle for the country and the people, it must be combined with morality.

A man, who has intellectual faculties but lacks morality, weighs the importance in approaching any undertaking and seeks after appreciation or personal honour. Such a man instinctively shrinks back when he is faced with a moment in which he has to risk his life, and he is liable to mentally collapse if he thinks that he is left alone on a deserted island.
For a revolutionary, steadfast ideology and ennobling morality can be said to be twin pillars that support his faith and personality.

Party schools should regard the work of implanting moral consciousness in the minds of the students and refining their moral traits as a pedagogical process which is as important as ideological education, and put the main stress on training all of them into true human beings who are possessed of unstained revolutionary conscience and moral obligation.

They should thoroughly eliminate all kinds of immoral and undisciplined practices that our Party guards and resolutely fights against, and the wrong viewpoint of regarding the course of studying at a Party school as a springboard for career development.

What I expect most of the Central Cadres Training School is that everything, which the students see, hear and feel on this campus, would become the nourishment for enabling them to cherish the revolutionary ideology of the Party and the political faith as unshakable ones and the lessons for developing their Party awareness and communist traits to be never forgotten throughout their life.

Simply by reading Comrade Kim Il Sung's autograph inscribed on the monument at the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK, the students would realize by themselves what they should learn first and what kind of persons they should become.
The word people, running through his precious instructions, describes in an intensive way what kind of person is an official necessary for the Party and the state.

With the passage of time, changes have taken place in the people's thinking and the mode of their activities, but the essence of our people, who entrust their destiny wholly to the Party and follow it, remains utterly unchanged and will never change in the future, too.
The mindset of the people is always on the side of the Party.

Some officials are obsessed with the material and economic factors rather than the ideological factor in Party work, claiming that the people of these days differ from those in the past era. Needless to say, it is an expression of ignorance of what faith and spirit defends and supports this country, or it is what the loafers, who have never properly embodied the Party's people-centred philosophy, say.
The appellation our great people is by no means a legacy of the past.

Countless are the citizens who have worked with devotion and still do so in different parts of the country for the Party and the state without expecting any remuneration or reward. Enshrined in their minds are pure and warm patriotism and loyalty which can never be compared with the value of any orders and medals.

Comrade Kim Jong Un said that in recent years the Party is putting forward the Party-founding generation, stressing the need to inherit its original ideals and spirit. This is because anti-people practices such as abuse of power, bureaucratism and accumulation of wealth by illicit means, which could not be found in the days of Party founding, have been revealed in the Party, he said, and continued:
People see and discern everything correctly.

To the officials who work sincerely for the sake of the Party and the state and who value the people as they would do their own parents, wives and children, the people not only open their heart but also guide them how to solve problems and teach them how to be resourceful, courageous and plucky.
The knack of gaining such an enormous asset is for the officials to prepare themselves into genuine Party officials equipped with Party spirit and people-oriented character.

The Central Cadres Training School should attach primary attention to educating and edifying its students with the aim of equipping them with our Party's outlook on the people, as well as tempering their Party spirit. In this way, it can help all of them acquire the spirit and trait of serving the people with faith and sincerity.

It would be a good idea to teach them with vivid examples how the first generation, who started the revolution following the great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung, fought believing only in the truth that they would emerge victorious in the revolution if they pooled the strength of the people and how painstakingly they strove to win over even a single person to the side of the revolution.

The school should give them an in-depth understanding of the Party's method of work with the masses so that they always mingle with the people and possess the ability of educating and moving them with skilful work method and style even in the face of unfamiliar situations.

It is important for this school to bring its education close to practical Party work and to give education that is closely combined with real situation. This is why it should proactively find out the experience and methods accumulated in the work with the people, the work with the masses, and apply them in its teaching.

Among the students, some, who made distinguished achievements by working well with the masses while staying on the job, can take the platform of a symposium or public presentation. This will be truthful and effective, I think.

The students in the six-month refresher course will complete their course soon. You and all others who will graduate from this school, mindful of the fact that you are sons and daughters of the working people and faithful servants and vanguard fighters of the people trained by our Party, should always make efforts to improve and train yourselves to become officials enjoying the people's affection and trust.
The present era demands Party officials who are possessed of specialist qualifications--who are capable of thinking and working with a fresh enterprising work style and innovative insight.

If he is a cadre of our Party, he should be an able political activist capable of grasping the actual conditions of his sector and unit promptly and correctly in the light of Party policy, presenting scientific methods with his clear-cut view, freely communicating with experts and other talented persons and rousing the organization and the masses to action, that is, a hands-on official capable of producing substantial results through persevering efforts.

Party schools should make every possible effort to help their students acquire in a historical and systematic way the immutable guidelines and programmes put forth in the whole course of the founding of our Party and its development, teach them the fundamental principles and methodology necessary for learning and applying more knowledge more quickly, and train them to be the Party building specialists, versatile persons, who have mastered the guidelines and detailed regulations of Party work and methods of presiding over various meetings so as to be proficient in practical Party work.
Party official should be an eloquent speaker and a competent writer capable of awakening the masses and arousing them to the implementation of Party policy.

Party schools should intensify education in composition, get the students to analyze and evaluate others' writings and regularly organize various presentations during lectures, discussions and daily routine, in order to improve their oratory and writing abilities, which are essential qualifications of Party officials, in the course of that.
Party schools are educational administration organs training Party cadres and, at the same time, important bases for studying the ideas and theories of Party building.

The Central Cadres Training School of the WPK and other Party schools at all levels should steadily intensify the study of the Party's ideas and theories for academically formulating and systematizing the ideas and theories put forward by the Party Central Committee and for demonstrating the validity of Party policies that are constantly developed and enriched.

They should make an in-depth study of the new Party building ideas, including the five-point Party-building line in the new era, and the pressing theoretical and practical problems in strengthening the whole Party, and also work out methodologies, plans and good ideas for Party work geared to solving the problems arising in reality.
They should create a model of advanced education so as to strongly promote the educational revolution in the new era.

Although society is developing rapidly and the scope of transformation is being expanded at present, Party schools still fail to overcome the old practice of cramming out-of-date knowledge into the students by systematizing it.
A day's stagnation at present results in a vast gap which would be difficult to address even if you make efforts for one hundred days, nay, a thousand days.
The reality in which a new stage of struggle for transformation is being waged is just the course of developing and enriching Party policy.

Party schools should regard it as their lifeline to put the teaching content on a Party-policy footing, sensitively reflect new Party's policies in the teaching of all subjects and constantly update the teaching content so that the students would correctly sense the development trend of the times.
They should also set examples in searching for and introducing advanced teaching methods and applying various information technologies to the education practice.

The guidance bureau for Party cadres training institutions under the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK should cooperate with educational units in all fields to share advanced teaching styles and methods and should ensure the sufficient and timely provision of teaching resources needed for the qualitative change in education at Party schools in provinces, cities and counties.

As it is the world's best political school, the Central Cadres Training School should keep updating the items and indexes which can be standards for the whole country also in educational administration.

As I have repeatedly stressed, Party officials should change first in order to make the country change and education at Party schools should change to that end and, before that, it is necessary to raise the ideological consciousness of the teaching staff of Party schools and improve their qualifications and abilities.
Comrade educators of the Central Cadres Training School and other Party schools at all levels who are making strenuous efforts at the honourable post for training our Party cadres,
Just as fruits are good when they are invariably tended by putting the whole mind, conscience and efforts, so will the results of education be.

Your platform and educational authority will change in height, if you possess good qualifications and personality, fully conscious of the reason why you are standing on this platform and the attitude with which to preserve your educational authority.

Mindful of the fact that the teachers of Party schools are ideological advocates and political activists of our Party before educators, you should constantly raise your Party spirit and political awareness, educate and inspire students with profound knowledge, outstanding teaching abilities, high academic authority and noble moral traits so that students can keep all their life the precious memories of the days when they learned and grew at Party schools.
I believe that you will channel all your energy and passion into the sacred cause of consolidating the strategic fortress for building the bright future of the WPK into an impregnable one.
Students who should shoulder the future of our Party and revolution,
You are studying and growing to your heart's content at the most prestigious university of the DPRK, the world-class political school at the time when each hour and each day are so invaluable.

Without forgetting even for a moment the expectations of the Party and the people, you should always be positive learners and active searchers to steadily improve your practical abilities and should read avidly so that you can be proud of having read really a lot of books in your school days.
Reliable pillars who are excellent in all aspects and capable of taking charge of any front and domain should be trained in large numbers just at this school.
Dear comrades,
We now stand here together with one mind and will and with a firm determination. This place will serve as another significant starting point for developing our Party and revolution.
The determination you are renewing at this moment and the efforts you will make will bring brilliant results to the Party and the country in the future.
Linking the honourable moment of today to the future, let us open up more courageously the broad avenue for Party building in the new era.
Glory to the future of the Central Cadres Training School of the Workers' Party of Korea! -0-

7f02ad1ee6ef01e35fb2f6a0491e09a5.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Newly-Inaugurated Nuclear Materials Production Factory
paragraphs: Pyongyang, June 4 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the newly-inaugurated nuclear materials production factory on June 3.
He was accompanied by leading officials of the munitions industry department of the WPK Central Committee and the Nuclear Weapons Institute of the DPRK.
Going round new production lines based on more sophisticated technology, Comrade Kim Jong Un learned about the factory's operation indices and its long-term production plan.
He highly appreciated the fact that the nuclear materials production sector is correctly implementing the decisions adopted at recent plenary meetings of the WPK Central Committee.

He praised the group of nuclear experts for having provided a firm guarantee to improve the efficiency of all system elements in the production line and further strengthen the foundation for the production of weapons-grade nuclear materials by settling the problems decisive in putting the production of nuclear materials on a Juche basis.

Saying that the weapons-grade nuclear materials production capacity more than doubled during the past 5-year course of bolstering up the nuclear force under the direct guidance of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK, he expressed satisfaction over the fact that the WPK's line of bolstering up nuclear forces is being thoroughly carried out thanks to the high technical capability developed by the nuclear science research group.

He recalled that the Ninth Congress of the WPK adopted a strategic decision to further expand the nuclear materials production capacity and continue to increase the nuclear arsenals in line with the prospective demand of the DPRK's nuclear force, when deciding on a new five-year plan for the strengthened nuclear force to steadily enhance the country's nuclear war deterrent.

The peculiarities of the Korean revolution inevitably accompanied by long-term confrontation with the most ferocious enemies, the existing threats getting more serious every moment, potential threats and unpredictable long-term crises further highlight the urgency and responsibility of the historic mission to bolster up both in quality and quantity and in a sustained and accelerated way the nuclear war deterrent, the basic guarantee and strong safety device for reliably ensuring the security, interests and development rights of the country, he noted.

Very clear is the stand taken by our Party and government to deal with all these complex changes in the subjective and objective environments and actively cope with them, and accordingly, it is the invariable political and military stand and responsible duty we should maintain to further expand and strengthen the state nuclear forces, the pivot in implementing the strategy to deter a war and fight a war, and thoroughly exercise the position of a nuclear weapons state, he declared.
That day, there was an important consultative meeting for bolstering up the nuclear forces.

Comrade Kim Jong Un made an important conclusion clarifying the action guidelines for rapidly accelerating the qualitative and quantitative strengthening of the DPRK's nuclear forces, saying that the conditions in which the nuclear materials production capacity has greatly expanded and the development of sophisticated nuclear technology create a mature environment for going into the new next-stage of bolstering up the nuclear forces and they offer the possibility of carrying out larger plans.
Finishing his important conclusion, Comrade Kim Jong Un said:
"Today we have updated the digits that are critical for our nuclear activities, and discussed some key matters.

In doing so, we have comprehensively considered the tactical and strategic requirements for building up our nuclear deterrent and, on the basis of this, adopted a highly responsible and crucial decision.

We have confirmed the order of priority for implementing the ambitious future plan designed to beef up our state’s nuclear forces at an exponential rate, as well as a requisite guarantee for the purpose.
This signifies an amazing, successful change that is beyond rhetorical description, a historic event that has set up an epochal milestone in rapidly upgrading our nuclear capabilities.
This nuclear potential that we have now is inconceivable apart from the worthwhile struggle we have conducted over the past five years.
Today, I would like to pay tribute, once again, to our nuclear scientists."

He stressed that the DPRK will as ever more thoroughly and more courageously take action to defend its constitution and sovereignty and reliably ensure the security of the state by exercising in a responsible manner the inviolable authority granted by the DPRK Constitution.

He expressed expectation and belief that the DPRK's group of nuclear experts would remain faithful to the fulfillment of the sacred mission for the perfect implementation of the decision adopted by the Party for the security of the country in the present and in the future.

Comrade Kim Jong Un's inspection of the new nuclear materials production factory serves as an important occasion in clearly highlighting once again the invariable will of our Party and state to bolster up the nuclear forces in order to guarantee the country's security and right to development, deter war and defend the regional and global peace and stability by highly developing the nuclear weapons, and the great potentialities and unlimited prospect. -0-

670b9f23b6486a04238ef40c55059867.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Observes Navigation Test of Destroyer Kang Kon
paragraphs: Pyongyang, June 6 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Destroyer Kang Kon of the Navy of the Korean People's Army, which has entered the shakedown for assessing its capability of executing operations, and observed its navigation test on June 4.

He was accompanied by Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Pak Kwang Sop, commander of the Navy, Pak Jong Chon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defence, Kim Kang Il, vice-minister of National Defence and director of the General Armaments Bureau, Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration, Kim Yong Hwan, president of the Academy of Defence Sciences, Kim Myong Son, director of the Armaments Examination Bureau of the Ministry of National Defence, commanding officers of the Navy and senior officials in the field of shipbuilding.

Comrade Kim Jong Un boarded the Destroyer Kang Kon and learned about the actual conditions of various combat duty spaces and elements of the destroyer including the combined control center, the plan for the navigation test and the phased schedule of the test of the warship's weapon systems.
A navigation test was conducted to assess different maneuvering elements of the destroyer with Comrade Kim Jong Un on board the warship.

Comrade Kim Jong Un praised the sailors for their high ability to operate the warship and expressed satisfaction over the cruise and high-speed maneuvering systems of the warship whose maneuverability is very good to meet operational requirements.

Referring to the global trend of the developing shipbuilding industry and the structural features of warship design, he clarified the important tasks for further perfecting the warship control system in our own way so as to meet the requirements for the performance of operational mission of our Navy.

It is possible to deter war and defend peace only when we possess substantial and powerful military muscle capable of exercising military sovereignty in a responsible manner in any space of the ground, the sea and the air, he said, adding this is the invariable view of the WPK and its national defence policy.

In particular, the issue of rapidly developing and strengthening the naval force of the DPRK into a force capable of reliably taking charge of a part of the nuclear war deterrent and into a group that can deal a deadly blow at the enemy any moment under the water or on the water is a matter which the WPK regards as the most important core task in the new five-year national defence development policy, he said.

Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed great trust and expectation that the vast plans for bolstering up the warship force, including the development and production of underwater secret weapons and the building of 10 000-tonnage destroyers under the five-year plan for modernizing the Navy approved by the Ninth Congress of the WPK, would be surely carried out by our reliable and powerful defence science research group, self-supporting shipbuilding industry and competent and intelligent workers in the munitions industry.

He warmly encouraged the officials, scientists and technicians of warship and weapon system research organs, hoping that they will successfully conduct the shakedown for assessing the operational executive capability of the destroyer and put the destroyers Choe Hyon and Kang Kon into commission for the Navy as soon as possible with an honorable sense of obligation and high sense of responsibility. -0-

162d8fa88fec25a7bd733fdfbbd724a7.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Major Munitions Industrial Enterprise to Learn about First Half-Yearly Production
paragraphs: Pyongyang, June 7 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected a major munitions industrial enterprise on June 6 to acquaint himself with the main weapons production in the first half of 2026.

Accompanying him were Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration, Pak Jong Chon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defence, Kim Kang Il, vice-minister of National Defence and director of the General Armaments Bureau, Kim Yong Hwan, president of the Academy of Defence Sciences, and leading officials of the Missile Administration.

Comrade Kim Jong Un highly praised the enterprise for fulfilling its first half-yearly plan for the main weapons production ahead of schedule and putting spurs to the preparations for the production in the second half of the year.

That day, he heard a report on the Missile Administration's long-term plan for expanding the capacity to produce various ballistic missiles and cruise missiles and gave an instruction to submit it to the Second Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK for deliberation.

It is necessary to boost the existing production capacity 2.5 times within the Five-Year Plan period on an annual growth basis in order to supply enough quantity of missiles the demand for which will drastically increase as our armed forces' operational group formation and combat organization are to be modified, he said, stressing that it is a core task of very important significance.

Underlining the need for the enterprise to establish the strict regulations and order for quality control and thoroughly observe the requirements of the inspection process so as to further improve the quality of products, he gave a series of instructions for its production and management. -0-

3c593d073242c0e65b407af7f28f6302.title: Respected Fatherly Marshal Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Delegates to Celebrations of 80th KCU Birthday
paragraphs: Pyongyang, June 7 (KCNA) -- The whole country is overflowing with the love and blessing of the benevolent father, who puts forward the schoolchildren as a pleasure and pride of the country and brings them the greatest honour and happiness, on the occasion of the 80th foundation anniversary of the Korean Children's Union (June 6).
The respected fatherly Marshal Kim Jong Un met on June 6 the representatives from Korean Children's Union organizations participating in the celebrations of the anniversary.
When he arrived at the venue for the photo session, the schoolchildren felt so happy that they broke into cheers of "Hurrah!"
The fatherly Marshal extended warm congratulations to the KCU members who attended the celebrations on behalf of all the KCU organizations of the country.

The course of the development of the KCU with its glorious history and tradition features a proud journey of having glorified the Workers' Party of Korea's idea of the Juche-oriented children's movement and leadership exploits and firmly prepared the rising generations as pillars of socialist Korea, he said, adding that it is the greatest strength and pride for our Party, state and people to have a revolutionary children's organization steadily inheriting the mind of pure loyalty and patriotism.

From the bright and cheerful looks of the new generation and their beautiful and noble ideological and moral qualities, our Party and people are getting indomitable strength and redoubled courage to overcome any trials and difficulties cheerfully, he said, adding with emotion that the bold spirit and dynamic footsteps of the KCU members growing up to be pillars for building a powerful country while flying high the flag of the KCU represent the strong breath and bright future of the country advancing nonstop.

He said that future Korea belongs to the KCU members and that our Party and people have shouldered the heavy burden of creation and construction for amazing changes and progress despite all sorts of difficulties and determinedly carried it into effect in order to hand down the strongest and most beautiful country to the coming generations. And he asked the KCU members to study hard and strive to become fine revolutionary and patriotic talents who will demonstrate the DPRK as the best country with their high ambition and ideal, iron will and wisdom.
Wishing happiness always to the KCU members, the future of socialist Korea, our powerful country, he had a photo session with the representatives.

The future of our country will be boundlessly bright and rosy as the new generations are growing up to be the masters of the future, holding Marshal Kim Jong Un in high esteem as their benevolent father. -0-

c78e25a8dfca587c8776e7a55cf1132b.title: Conference Held with Splendor to Commemorate 80th KCU Birthday
paragraphs: Pyongyang, June 7 (KCNA) -- The Korean Children's Union, a mass political organization of schoolchildren who are the future and hope of our state and people, is proudly marking its 80th founding anniversary in its history of glorious succession and growth.

The KCU has steadily developed into the ranks of juvenile revolutionaries and patriots who are firmly carrying on the revolution and patriotism generation after generation, adding luster to the sacred history and tradition created in the battlefields of Mt Paektu, for the past 80 years since it was founded as the Juche-oriented children's revolutionary organization in the first period of nation building.

All the people across the country are convinced of the bright future of our state and our cause when they look at the bright and lively appearance of the rising generation who are growing up to be stalwart pillars of the DPRK in the future, bringing their hope and talents into full bloom under the care of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea and the grateful socialist motherland. And they are extending warm congratulations to the KCU members across the country on the significant June holiday.

A conference in commemoration of the 80th KCU founding anniversary was held with splendor at Kim Il Sung Stadium in the capital city of Pyongyang on June 6 amid special concern and expectation of the Party, government and people.
Marshal Kim Jong Un, the benevolent father of all the schoolchildren across the country, attended the conference.

When Marshal Kim Jong Un appeared on the platform, the schoolchildren broke into cheers as an expression of their highest honour and pride of significantly commemorating the founding anniversary of the KCU with the fatherly Marshal, whom they yearned for even in their dreams, in presence and fireworks were set off, rocking the stadium.

All the participants extended thanks to the fatherly Marshal who has worked heart and soul to make the schoolchildren enjoy the greatest happiness in the most dignified country, powerful and prosperous, regarding the work for the younger generation as the most important affair directly linked with the future of the revolution and the destiny of the state.
Representatives of the KCU organizations presented bouquets of fragrant flowers to Marshal Kim Jong Un and tied a red necktie of the KCU around his neck.
The fatherly Marshal extended warm congratulations to the members of the KCU on its significant 80th founding anniversary amid the blessing of the whole country.

Present there were Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan, Ju Chang Il and Kim Sung Du, secretaries of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Su Gil, chief secretary of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the WPK, representatives of the KCU organizations including the members of relay teams carrying letters of loyalty, members of the delegation of Korean schoolchildren in Japan, students of revolutionary schools, members of the KCU, sub-branch instructors and officials of the youth league in Pyongyang.
There was a ceremony of hoisting the national flag of the DPRK.
The exemplary KCU members hoisted the glorious national flag amid the solemn playing of the DPRK national anthem.

The sacred national flag, being hoisted in solemn reverence, made the hearts of the participants burn with the desire to demonstrate the dignity and honor of our most beautiful and greatest country generation after generation.

The representatives of the KCU organizations courteously presented the fatherly Marshal with letters of loyalty reflecting the boundless wishes of the KCU members across the country and their pledge of succession.
Ju Chang Il, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, made a report at the conference.

The reporter said that the KCU members are celebrating the auspicious founding anniversary of their organization with the greatest joy and happiness and it is the honor that they can receive only under the care of the motherly WPK which brings earlier the prosperous ideal society with love and sincerity for the rising generation. He referred to the proud 80-year history of the KCU which has recorded all the annals of its founding and development with patriotic loyalty.

He said that the KCU members are growing up to be juvenile revolutionaries and patriots dynamically advancing along the road of patriotism as they are holding in high esteem the fatherly Marshal who pursues the socialist policy for schoolchildren as the consistent policy of the Party and the eternal state policy of the DPRK and takes warm care of them so that they can learn with nothing more to desire, grow up excellently and bring their hope and talents into full bloom.

He extended the warmest thanks to the fatherly Marshal for bringing up the KCU members to be true sons and daughters of the socialist country and showing constant loving care and benevolence to them, reflecting the unanimous mind of the schoolchildren, educators and parents across the country.

The reporter said that the new era of national prosperity, in which everything on this land is undergoing change beyond recognition, leads the beautiful dreams and hopes of the KCU members towards a brighter future, calling on the schoolchildren to more firmly prepare themselves as reserves for socialist construction.
The respected fatherly Marshal Kim Jong Un made a significant congratulatory speech on the 80th founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union.
"Our proud Children’s Union members,
This is June 6, your holiday.

On this holiday, 80th founding anniversary of your organization, the whole country is sending greetings of congratulation to all of you, Children’s Union members, who are precious sons and daughters of our people and masters of the future of this Korea.
As I see your neat and vigorous appearance, I really feel reassured.
Children’s Union members,

Overcoming the harsh trials as it sees you and creating more with greater exertion as it wishes that the rising generation will lead a happy life with nothing to envy--this is the course of, and secret to, this country achieving prosperity.
Beloved Children’s Union members,

You should not forget that the richer knowledge you acquire, the more healthily and stoutly you grow up and the greater feeling of helping and leading one another forward you cherish in your mind, the stronger your country will become and the happier the laughter will be in the streets, villages, workplaces and houses across the country.
You should steadily shoulder the future of this country.
My wish is that you will all be filial to your parents, study hard and be exemplary in the organizational life in good health.
I really feel happier today than any other days.
It is because I am sure that, as it has you, our country will become more youthful and beautiful.
Children’s Union members,
Let us all march forward courageously towards the future as befitting the sons and daughters of Korea."
When the Marshal finished his speech, the members of the KCU, who received great love and trust from the benevolent father, broke into enthusiastic cheers of "Hurrah!"
All the participants made a pledge of loyalty to the fatherly Marshal.

The members of the KCU made a solemn oath to become reliable pillars of the country and true sons and daughters boundlessly loyal to the country by learning and learning for the DPRK, always bearing deep in mind the gratitude to the motherly Workers' Party of Korea, which is taking warm care of them as the new generation of the DPRK.
Then followed a march of resolution of the new generation.
With a column under the national flag of the DPRK in the van, the KCU members marched vigorously, flying the flag of the KCU ahead of their columns, as a pledge of loyalty and repayment.

The columns of revolutionary schools and the columns of the provincial KCU members dynamically marched with the enthusiasm to glorify the glorious tradition of the Anti-Japanese Children's Corps generation after generation and become the masters of a prosperous power, who are knowledgeable, moral and healthy and imbued with ardent patriotism.

The sky of June resounded with the slogans chanted by the marchers reflecting the firm determination of all the KCU members to be always ready for the socialist country, trusting and following only the fatherly Marshal who defends and brings into full bloom the dreams and hopes of the rising generation and the bright future of the country which will be rosy forever.

The conference significantly concluded amid the resounding of the song "Marshal Kim Jong Un Is Our Father" sang by the KCU members in chorus out of their boundless gratitude to the fatherly Marshal who took a benevolent measure to celebrate June 6 as a national holiday every year and brings the greatest happiness to them.

The fatherly Marshal warmly waved to the new generation, the reliable successors to the revolution who would firmly carry forward the baton of the Juche cause, and wished the KCU members the bright future.

The conference marked a significant occasion of clearly showing the proud appearance and mettle of our KCU members, who are growing up to be pillars of future socialist Korea under the guidance of the respected fatherly Marshal Kim Jong Un, and of further encouraging the people across the country to bring earlier the bright future of national prosperity with towering self-confidence and redoubled enthusiasm. -0-

0703dd713d5e03b4f8c3dd457e08eaf3.title: Historic Meeting to Be Specially Recorded in Chronicle of DPRK-China Friendship Ceremony of Welcoming Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of C.C., CPC and President of PRC, Held with Splendor
paragraphs: Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- The Korean people are warmly welcoming the goodwill mission of the fraternal Chinese people on a state visit to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea as the greatest state guest.

A ceremony took place at Kim Il Sung Square on June 8 to welcome Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China.

Seen at the square with the national flags of the DPRK and China fluttering were the guard of honor and the honorary cavalry of the Korean People's Army and the Central Military Band of the Ministry of National Defence.

Attending the ceremony were Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, Kim Jae Ryong and Ri Il Hwan, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretaries of the C.C., WPK, Kim Song Nam, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the C.C., WPK, Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, and Kim Su Gil, chief secretary of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the WPK.
Pyongyang citizens, youth and students and children were standing with national flags of the two countries and flowers.
Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, came to the venue for the ceremony.
Comrade Xi Jinping's private car arrived at Kim Il Sung Square.
Amid the playing of welcome music, Comrade Kim Jong Un, together with his wife Ri Sol Ju, warmly greeted Comrade Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan.
Comrade Kim Jong Un introduced to Comrade Xi Jinping senior Party, government and military officials of the DPRK.

Comrade Kim Jong Un exchanged greetings with entourage members of the Chinese side including Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the CPC Central Committee and minister of Foreign Affairs, Liu Haixing, head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee, Tang Fangyu, director of the Policy Research Office of the CPC Central Committee, Dong Jun, minister of National Defence of the PRC, Zheng Shanjie, head of the National Development and Reform Committee of the PRC, and Wang Wentao, minister of Commerce of the PRC.
A ceremony of welcoming Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, began.
A 21-gun salute was fired amid the solemn playing of the national anthems of the PRC and the DPRK.
Comrade Xi Jinping received a salute from the chief of the KPA guard of honor.
Guided by Comrade Kim Jong Un, Comrade Xi Jinping reviewed the KPA guard of honor.
There took place a march-past of the KPA guard of honor.
When the welcoming ceremony was over, loud cheers were raised.
Comrade Xi Jinping expressed heartfelt thanks to the Korean Party, government and people for their hospitality.

The masses broke into enthusiastic cheers, looking up to the top leaders who are further consolidating the ties of DPRK-China friendship, which have steadily maintained their nature century after century and generation after generation, and energetically guiding them to the strategic expansion and development in conformity with the requirements of the new era and the aspirations and wishes of the peoples of the two countries.
The top leaders of the DPRK and China warmly waved back to the cheering masses.
Comrade Xi Jinping's private car headed toward the Kumsusan State Guesthouse, lodging quarters, getting an ovation along the route.
Comrade Kim Jong Un accompanied Comrade Xi Jinping to his lodgings.

The Pyongyang meeting overflowing with close friendship and warm feelings between the top leaders of the two countries was clearly recorded in history as an event of showing once again the DPRK-China relationship that has invariably carried forward the good tradition generation after generation and is making a new history of friendship and solidarity for the more beautiful future. -0-

0948c87de7c61b95a1e4fe4cd30bb3bb.title: Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of C.C., CPC and President of PRC, Arrives in Pyongyang to Pay State Visit to DPRK Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Warmly Welcomes Comrade Xi Jinping
paragraphs: Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- The historic Pyongyang meeting between the top leaders of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the People's Republic of China was arranged again at a time when the traditional DPRK-China friendship, forged in the long journey for independence against imperialism, peace and the accomplishment of the socialist cause, weathering all hard-ships of the times, is being developed at a new strategic level.

Comrade Xi Jinping's visit to the DPRK in the significant year marking the 65th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance serves as the important and meaningful one in developing the DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations, the strategic option and valuable common asset of the two parties and the peoples of the two countries.
The national flags of the two countries were fluttering at the flagstaffs.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju came to Pyongyang International Airport to greet Comrade Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan.
Present at the airport were Wang Yajun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy officials.
Comrade Xi Jinping's private plane landed at the airport at noon on Monday.
Comrade Kim Jong Un had an impressive meeting with Comrade Xi Jinping.
Comrade Kim Jong Un shook hands with Comrade Xi Jinping, expressing his pleasure over their reunion in Pyongyang nine months after the significant meeting in Beijing last September.
Comrade Xi Jinping expressed his deep thanks to Comrade Kim Jong Un for warmly welcoming him, while giving his impressions of revisit to Pyongyang in seven years.
